source_rows.literal: This is a consolidated list of the announced (and sometimes observed) changes in the [[User Interface]] [[API]]'s and functionality for the [[Burning Crusade]] expansion (2.0) release. Please note that this thread is to discuss the upcoming changes and any clarifications or features that are a direct result of those changes, or things which we've been asked to remind [[slouken]] of.

source_rows.literal: WoW 2.0 represents a major change in the UI code, and as such ALL [[AddOn]]s will need to be updated before they will work, if for no other reason than the [[Lua]] 5.0 to Lua 5.1 changes. Some AddOns will be more seriously affected, and a few will have to be redesigned.

source_rows.literal: ==Significant Changes==
source_rows.heading: Significant Changes
source_rows.limit: Header/navigation only; no expanded contract.

source_rows.literal: * WoW 2.0 has upgraded to Lua 5.1.1 as it provides a number of benefits (notably incremental garbage collection and efficient varargs). There ARE some incompatible changes from Lua 5.0, authors should read the [http://www.lua.org/manual/5.1 Lua manual]; main points include:
source_rows.heading: Significant Changes
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: ** Iteration over tables in a for loop now requires use of the pairs function: thus, for k,v in table do becomes for k,v in pairs(table) do
source_rows.heading: Significant Changes
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: ** Size of the array portion of the table is no longer stored in the ''n'' key: thus, size = t.n or table.getn(t) becomes size = #t using the new # size operator.
source_rows.heading: Significant Changes
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: ** Functions may now use the vararg argument (...) to take a variable number of arguments without having to declare them in the function signature.
source_rows.heading: Significant Changes
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * There is a new unit "focus" which behaves like target, the "PLAYER_FOCUS_CHANGED" event is fired when it is changed, and you receive unit events for this unit.
source_rows.heading: Significant Changes
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * The protected code mechanism introduced in 1.10 has been extended to cover more functions. Blizzard code is considered secure, all other code is untrusted.
source_rows.heading: Significant Changes
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: == Protected Code ==
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: Header/navigation only; no expanded contract.

source_rows.literal: The following function types are restricted for AddOns;
source_rows.heading: Protected Code

source_rows.literal: * Movement is never allowed.
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * Spell casting and targetting (including focus) are only allowed using secure templates or special slash commands (not /script).
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * Programatic modification of macros, key bindings, and the action bar page only allowed outside of combat.
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * Trading, placing auction bids, querying LFG, crafting, and reloading the UI are only allowed interactively.
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * Action buttons and targeting frames are now "protected". Protected frames cannot be programmatically moved, shown or hidden, or have their attributes (unit, action, etc) changed during combat.
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * Dueling, dismissing your pet, and abandoning your pet are no longer protected functions. *2.0.3* - Possibly not working right
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: In addition:
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * Script handlers defined in SecureXML templates remain secure when they are inherited, unless overridden by AddOn code.
source_rows.heading: Protected Code
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * The parent of a protected frame is implicitly protected also, as are any frames which it is anchored to.

source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: Also note the following clarifications and details:

source_rows.literal: * /target, /focus, and /startattack take all valid unit ids (as well as entity names in the case of /target) Where applicable they default to target if no unit is specified.

source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * In WoW 2.0, feeding your pet, poisons, etc. will be even easier to macro: /cast Feed Pet then /use Dry Pork Ribs. You will also be able to click on food in your action bar when you are targeting Feed Pet and other item targeting spells.

source_rows.heading: Slash Commands

source_rows.literal: ==Conditional Macro Commands==
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: Header/navigation only; no expanded contract.

source_rows.literal: The /startattack, /stopattack, /stopcasting, /cast*, /use*, /cancelaura, /changeactionbar, /equip*, /pet*, /target*, /cleartarget, /focus, /clearfocus, /assist and /click commands can be given multiple actions and conditions on which to use those actions. The first matching action will be used.
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: The /startattack, /petattack commands also support the [target=unit] option syntax. '''*2.0.3*'''
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: The syntax is as follows:
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: /command [''option''] ''action''; [''option1,option2''] ''action''
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: If multiple conditions are provided for an action, they must all be met before the action will happen. The conditions supported are as follows:
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * target=unit - Run the command and perform tests on the specified unit (only applicable to spell casting or item use). You can specify 'none' as a target unit to act as if you have no target.
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * help/harm - Choose depending on whether target is assistable or attackable
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * combat - Choose depending on whether you're in combat or not
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * stance or stance:# - Choose depending on your stance/shapeshift ("stance" alone matches any stance)
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * stealth - Choose depending on whether you are stealthed
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * mounted - Choose depending on whether you are mounted
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * swimming - Choose depending on whether you are swimming
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * flying - Choose depending on whether you are flying
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * indoors - Choose depending on whether you are indoors
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * outdoors - Choose depending on whether you are outdoors
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * modifier or modifier:shift|ctrl|alt - Choose depending on any modifier keys you're holding at the time the macro runs
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * equipped:''<invslot>''|''<itemclass>''|''<itemsubclass>'' - Choose if you have the specific item type equipped
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * actionbar:<bar> - Choose if a specific actionbar is shown
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * button:Z - Choose if the specified button is held down
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * pet:''<name>''|''<family>'' - Choose if your current active pet has the specified name or family (e.g. pet:bear/wolf)
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * channeling or channeling:spell - Choose if you are channeling (possibly a specific spell)
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * exists - Choose if the target exists
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * dead - Choose if the target is dead
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: For stance and modifier you can list multiple matching values separated by the / character for the condition to be true if ANY of them are true. For example modifier:shift/ctrl matches if shift or control is held down.
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: Any condition can be prefixed with 'no' to select if it does NOT match. For example [nocombat]
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * There is a new /stopmacro ''[condition,...]'' command that stops macro execution if the specified conditions are met. e.g. /stopmacro [''stealth''].
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * The pet action commands (/petattack etc) also allow for conditional execution as above.
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * As a special case, if you /focus with the target=focus, or /target with the target=target, it will use the argument as the target instead. e.g. /focus [target=focus,noexists] pet will focus on the pet if the focus doesn't exist. '''*2.0.3*'''
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * For the player, pet, party members and pets, and raid members and pets, you can now substitute the name of the unit anywhere a unit token is normally used. '''*2.0.3*'''
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * In battlegrounds you can suffix the name with -<realm> (e.g. -Silver Hand) to reference a player from a specific realm. '''*2.0.3*'''
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.

source_rows.literal: * You can suffix name or unit ID with -target to get the unit's target, and (for party and raid members) -pet to get the unit's pet. '''*2.0.3*'''
source_rows.heading: Conditional Macro Commands
source_rows.limit: UNPROVEN: complete literal prose/example retained; no runtime or native observation.
